scope: Waypoint 1: implement a server-owned deterministic R8 strategic decision boundary without any Gemini call, provider dependency or runtime activation.
Produce a compact full-arena 64 by 36 ASCII battlefield with exact actor, objective and support facts, a bounded committed-voyage carrier, recent-change carrier and stable basis identity.

Prepare 8 to 12 legal complete-turn candidates including the existing deterministic fallback, exact immediate consequences, future opportunities, risks and explicit uncertainty within the six-second whole-window ceiling.
Resolve model-facing candidate IDs only through current-basis one-use server capabilities and freeze strict selected/abstention response, pending/executing/committed evidence and byte/search caps.
Verify deterministic reconstruction, paired-world projection distinctions, capability rejection, response validation and detached-projection parity with authoritative R8 execution.
Waypoint 2: add a data-only, one-call local-fake adapter with a six-second whole-window deadline, strict response validation, no retry, abort, concurrency, request-budget and circuit-breaker bounds.

Integrate the strategic boundary with the private R8 coordinator through an atomic chosen-plan and pending/executing/committed voyage record while keeping all execution authority inside the current-basis resolver.
Persist the strategy policy and at most eight strategic turns in R8 replay; reconstruct committed and final uncommitted-prefix states without a provider and reject altered or extended evidence.
Attribute player counteractions separately from system changes, preserve original continuation deadlines and accepted temporary cost, and keep deterministic fallback source attribution explicit.
Waypoint 3: integrate the exact stable gemini-3.6-flash model through direct server-only structured-output REST with low thinking, strict usage parsing and no SDK dependency.
Keep Gemini shadow proposals outside execution authority while retaining source-correct pending evidence, timing, token and frozen introductory-cost measurements for every validated provider result.

Fail external configuration closed, isolate ordinary quality runs from the provider, retain cancellation/concurrency/request-budget/circuit bounds and prevent the API key or provider endpoint from entering the client bundle.
Freeze five deterministic-baseline behavioral probes and prospective useful/valid/on-time/fallback/authority/cost thresholds before collecting real deployed shadow results.

Correct deployed shadow measurement so total time covers preparation, provider and validation, and expose only allowlisted provider failure categories without retaining provider bodies, raw exceptions or credentials.

After the first Gemini 3.6 gate, retain sanitized diagnostics in the probe artifact, measure live-equivalent planner and boundary preparation, state the 160-character output limit through supported schema descriptions, advance the changed instruction to exact prompt r2, and make the temporary-cost fixture expose an explicit committed route and delayed benefit without changing thresholds or authority.

After the corrected r2 gate, add bounded deterministic ASCII and structured after-state deltas to every candidate, remove fallback identity from the model-facing brief, independently neutralize candidate identity and presentation order while retaining private server fallback authority, advance to prompt r3 and brief r2, and apply the owner-authorized eight-second whole-window deadline.
Advance to prompt r4 with a compact shared turn-based destructible-world gameplay contract and exactly one active-mode clause derived from the selected Collect, Defend or Claim objective.
non_goals: No Gemini SDK, API key, network call, provider adapter, prompt execution, shadow mode or live model selection in Waypoint 1.
No coordinator activation, player-visible behavior, R8 public promotion, Daily/reward/PEI change, deployment variable or external-service mutation.
No change to existing R8 physics, deterministic fallback selection, objective rules, presentation, assets or legacy runtime support.
No Sorcerers source, asset or implementation input.
No Gemini SDK, API key, network call, live model selection, environment variable, deployment mutation or provider expense in Waypoint 2.
Local Waypoint 3 implementation verification does not perform a real Gemini call, mutate Render, activate live Gemini selection, promote R8 to standard Practice/Daily or change PEI/reward behavior.
Candidate deltas report simulated after-state facts and must not invent route reachability classifications that the deterministic server has not established.
The gameplay contract must not include rules for the two objective modes the player did not select.

reviews.details: The boundary is isolated from runtime activation, accepts only a server-computed fallback, exposes causal summaries rather than operations and keeps provider output outside execution authority. Direct review bound fallback identity into the basis, made issued capabilities globally one-use across equivalent rebuilt boundaries, froze nested strategic inputs and preserved the contract allowance for a sparse atlas when fewer than eight distinct legal turns exist. The optimized detached projection reuses current R7 combat mechanics and applies R8 objective support/contact semantics; a complete-turn parity regression found no immediate consequence difference.

The adapter receives only a compact data brief and cannot access execution, session, replay or reward authority. Direct review kept all model-shaped output behind strict syntax, current-brief semantics and one-use capabilities; retained the selection and voyage before execution; committed only after observation; separated provider, fallback and feedback attribution; and verified no external provider dependency or secret exists. reviews.details: The direct REST transport sends only the bounded brief, validates one complete structured response and exact usage metadata, discards raw provider failures and never receives capabilities or execution authority. reviews.details: Review accepts the artifact as evidence of another failed strategy gate. reviews.reviewer: primary assistant direct r3 candidate-delta and neutral-presentation review
reviews.details: Every public candidate now carries deterministic simulated after-state evidence relative to the authoritative current 64x36 battlefield: bounded ASCII row deltas, changed actor and object facts, and committed-target status, support, position and distance. Authoritative-turn coverage reconstructs every encoded before/after span and checks actor/object facts against the executed state. Deltas are capped at 512 bytes per candidate with explicit truncation and do not claim route reachability the simulation has not established. The model-facing brief no longer contains fallback identity; candidate ID assignment and list presentation use separate deterministic basis-derived orders. reviews.details: The request now explains the shared world needed to interpret the brief: alternating complete turns, destructible support/routes/landings, stitching and fall elimination, physical indestructible objective objects, before-state versus candidate after-state and the strategic role of a temporary local cost. One mode clause is selected directly from the server-owned objective enum. residual_risks: The r4 deployment must pass exactly one new five-probe shadow gate with at least four valid, useful and on-time choices, no more than one provider fallback, zero authority violations, p95 at or below eight seconds and total estimated cost at or below USD 0.05 before live selection is considered.

Candidate deltas expose deterministic resulting terrain, actor, object and committed-target facts but do not establish route reachability. Whether Gemini can infer strategically useful continuity from those bounded facts remains unproven until the deployed r4 gate.
The 16.2-18.7 KB local briefs and roughly 1.1-1.3 second local preparation remain within their caps, but their deployed token and latency effect is not yet measured.

The preserved r1 artifact remains incomplete historical evidence because it omitted diagnostics and recorded preparation as zero; the corrected r2 artifact supersedes it for current operational measurement.
The corrected r2 artifact remains failed historical evidence at 1/5 usefulness and 5,999 ms p95; it does not qualify r4 and will not be rerun unchanged.
